compatibility: Meta-learning bundles, multi-task bundles, online bundles, active-learning bundles, semi-supervised bundles, self-supervised bundles, anomaly bundles, unsupervised bundles, classical pipeline bundles, Torch trainer bundles, RAG bundles, and Session checkpoints are complementary, not interchangeable. A meta-learning bundle (buildml.metalearning_bundle.v1) stores a MetaLearningPlan (episodic few-shot protocol + feature/task contract + optional warm-start init estimator). A Session checkpoint stores data, roles, splits, history, and optional classical preprocess plans; it does not embed the meta-learner. Reload tabular workflow via checkpoint_load; reload the learner via load_metalearning_bundle. This is practical tabular few-shot / episodic meta-learning — not foundation-model MAML-at-scale.
